name: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
description:
About This Game

Wildfires are spreading faster, burning hotter, and becoming harder to control. You are part of an international firefighting unit, stationed at your firehouse with your crew and ready to respond at a moment’s notice.

You’ve been called to respond! Get behind the wheel of your wildland fire engine and race to the scene, but watch your driving. Flames can damage your vehicle, rough terrain can weaken it, and reckless driving can leave you stranded.

Your first priority? Find and rescue civilians who may be trapped or injured. Locate them, assess their condition, provide first aid, and coordinate their evacuation before the fire closes in. Once everyone is safe, it’s time to face the blaze. 

Clear vegetation, use your firefighting tools, deploy tactical backfires, manage your hoses, and carefully conserve your water to stay one step ahead of the flames.

But fire isn’t your only threat. Smoke can intoxicate you if you remain exposed for too long. Manage your positioning carefully and use your breathing mask to stay safe. And keep an eye on your crew too.

Wildfires are unpredictable, and sometimes even the best-laid plans aren’t enough. When the situation escalates, make fast tactical decisions and call in reinforcements through your map.

Deploy water bombers to drop water or fire retardant over advancing flames. Request helicopters for rapid insertion or extraction. Running low on water? Call for a water delivery before the situation spirals out of control.

Every decision can make the difference.

Our dynamic fire system simulates how flames spread and evolve based on factors such as wind, terrain, vegetation, and weather conditions. A fire that looks manageable one moment can become a major threat the next.

Adapt your strategy, react to changing conditions, and work with your crew to stay one step ahead of the flames.

Quick thinking and smart coordination are key to mastering the blaze across two distinct game modes:

  • Put yourself in the shoes of a firefighter deployed for a fire season like no other. The immersive campaign mode will guide you through various missions. Completing missions unlocks new operations, each introducing unique objectives, terrain, and tactical challenges.

  • Organize your team in our sandbox mode, featuring dynamic objectives and procedural fire behavior to ensure every mission feels different. 

Each intervention will test your nerves and your ability to adapt. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

  • Fight massive wildfires. Face large-scale fires alone or with up to 4 players in co-op.

  • Experience a dynamic wildfire system powered by procedural simulation. Fire spreads and evolves according to factors such as wind, terrain, vegetation, and weather conditions.

  • Rescue civilians. Locate victims, provide first aid, and coordinate their evacuation before the fire reaches them.

  • Use real-world-inspired firefighting equipment. From chainsaws to carrying frames to hose systems and breathing masks.

  • Operate a fleet of firefighting vehicles and get them safely into position.

  • Manage your water supply. Refill from water tanks, ponds, or other vehicles.

  • Call in tactical support. Deploy water bombers, request water deliveries, or call for ground support to establish attack or defense lines.

  • Two game modes: campaign or sandbox mode.

  • Explore diverse environments. Fight fires across maps inspired by some of the world's wildest regions, each with unique terrain and challenges.
short_desc: Become a wildland firefighter and battle raging wildfires around the world. Play solo or in co-op to rescue civilians, operate specialized vehicles, and outsmart fast-spreading, dynamic fires.
